column1: # Access 97 (Jet3; sort order 1033) text index keys written by ACE 12.0 (DAO.DBEngine.120, 32-bit) into a Jet3 .mdb it created:
# every character of code page 1252 alone, every pair of its letters that have or can have an accent or
# are keyed as two letters, and 5,000 values of 3 to 12 of its characters. Ascending (7F...) and descending
# (80...). One value per line: its code points in hex, then the two keys. Made by tools/ace-text-keys.ps1,
# which has the engine index each value and reads the index pages back.
